players.product: NdPr oxide and sintered NdFeB permanent magnets

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Apple: in July 2025 MP Materials entered a definitive, long-term supply agreement with Apple for the development, manufacture and supply of magnets from the Independence Facility, plus a commercial-scale, dedicated recycling line at Mountain Pass producing rare earths from post-industrial and post-consumer recycled feedstock. Subject to specified milestones, Apple agreed to prepay $200.0 million in aggregate for magnets; MP received $40.0 million in September 2025 and became entitled to a further $32.0 million in December 2025. The $72.0 million is non-current deferred revenue, with performance expected to begin no earlier than 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: $200.0 million aggregate prepayments; $40.0 million received; $32.0 million receivable; $72.0 million deferred; revenue no earlier than 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Customer General Motors: under the long-term supply agreement with GM, MP Materials had collected all required prepayments for magnetic precursor products (NdPr metal) totaling $150.0 million (the final $50.0 million in April 2025). As of December 31, 2025 it had sold $66.9 million of these products to GM and remained obligated to transfer the remaining $83.1 million, expected throughout 2026 and the first half of 2027; MP then expects no further precursor sales to GM and anticipates beginning sales of finished magnets to GM in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: $150.0 million prepayments collected; $66.9 million sold; $83.1 million remaining (2026 to first half of 2027); finished magnets to GM from 2026

quarterly_data.signal: MP Materials' 10-K revenue by product (in thousands): NdPr oxide and metal $115,131 in 2025 (+99%) versus $57,762 in 2024; rare earth concentrate $41,992 (-71%) versus $144,363; magnetic precursor products $66,861 in their first year (sales began in Q1 2025 under the GM agreement); total revenue $224,441 (+10%) versus $203,855. The Magnetics segment generated $66.9 million in its first year of substantial results, and NdFeB permanent magnet manufacturing at Independence started in late 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: NdPr oxide and metal $115,131 thousand (+99%); rare earth concentrate $41,992 thousand (-71%); magnetic precursor products $66,861 thousand; total revenue $224,441 thousand (+10%)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Shenghe: under the Shenghe Offtake Agreement, Shenghe was obligated to purchase MP Materials' rare earth concentrate on a take-or-pay basis as its exclusive distributor in China (with exceptions for MP's direct sales globally). MP also bought reagent products and other materials from Shenghe, totaling $19.7 million, $4.8 million and $8.3 million in 2025, 2024 and 2023 while Shenghe was a related party.
quarterly_data.figure: purchases from Shenghe $19.7 million (2025), $4.8 million (2024), $8.3 million (2023)
